name: student-care
description: Student Care — Multi-Tenant School Management Platform with Dedicated Database Isolation

scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['packages/shared-types/dist', 'services/api/dist', 'apps/web/.next'].forEach(p => fs.existsSync(p) && fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true }));"
